venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL came in -44.6% vs target on Monday ($707 net vs $1,277).** Food $55. Comps $23.99 (3.4%, industry love + a marketing comp). 21 guests / $33.68 GCA. **A very quiet Monday to open the week** - a good day to get thorough with FOH/BOH cleaning, with fruit-fly counts dropping significantly thanks to staff diligence. A second AV company gave a quote on the projector install (guests are already engaging with the new screen), and there was growing curiosity around the vending machine (disposable cameras, merch, snacks). Kendal is in town today/tomorrow shooting social content. HVAC scheduled tomorrow for the non-responsive second thermostat; the space stayed well air-conditioned. Low/86: cast iron (Nixta still quoted 6/30 arrival). No incident; no-shows not charged. MOD: MKZ. Entered by MKZ.

Kitchen smooth with good sales. Maintenance: chiller. No incident; no-shows not charged. MOD/Chef: KE/JM. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR came in -21.6% vs target on Monday ($7,499.42 net vs $9,570.62).** Segments: DC/AM $1,036.53 + D&C PM $6,462.89; Garden/6A closed. Food $1,836.20. Comps $341.51. 204 guests (Tock) / $36.76 GCA. **A steady Monday with no early cuts and a flood of memorable guest moments.** AM blazed by with decent numbers (finished cold brew, made black iced tea, deep-cleaned drains); PM stayed steady to the end despite a brief fryer scare ~9:30p (relit and back in service for chicken tickets). Kitchen ran a slow 'Oyster Monday.' Standout stories: a widow flew in from New York to accept an organ-donation award for her late husband and photographed our 'Wish You Were Here' neon alongside a leftover Pride butterfly that moved her to tears (her meal was comped); plus a newly engaged couple road-tripping their dating-history landmarks after a Rockies-game proposal. Heads up: Women in Venture Capital networking event tomorrow (25 guests, 11a-5p, Vauxhall). Breaks complete; no incident; no-shows not charged. MOD: Carey (AM) / Maggie H (PM). Entered by Maggie H.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Crummy rain and humidity all evening
venues.narrative: **DCEV came in -38.4% vs target on Monday ($2,629 net vs $4,270).** Food $342 / Beverage $2,287. Comps $95 (3.5%). 79 guests / $33 GCA. **A rainy, humid Monday after a week of NYC partying/events made for a very slow night on 6th** - weather deterred walk-ins and kept some reservations away. Still created nice experiences for a birthday group at T7 and a visitor (Kyler's friend Grace from back home); lots of wine and beer, plus strong oyster sales (~70-80). A fast, professional close. 86 arancini (likely to stay, with the new menu dropping soon). No-shows charged; 1 DOF breakage. Maintenance: metal floor piece by service needs to be screwed/replaced. (Backfilled - report posted 6/23 12:45 ET, after the prior run.) MOD/Chef: Cara / Alejandro. Entered by Nick.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA beat target +44.9% on Monday ($4,328 net vs $2,986).** All Marquee ($4,328); Standing Room $0; food $1,017 (a strong food push, with lamb burgers actively promoted). Comps $128 (walk-out tab + anniversary bubbles). 109 guests / $86.56 check avg. **A mostly mellow night with good vibes** until an ~11pm verbal altercation escalated to the point of escorting a party out, with the company eating the tab (a formal incident report will follow). Otherwise guests had a great time; an easy-money close wrapped up around 1:15am. ~30-40 unshucked oysters left over. Maintenance: kitchen low-boy gasket fully off; Kitchen 3 middle comp sink very leaky. 86: contrabandista, amburana, tximista. Incident: yes; no-shows charged. MOD/Chef: Mikey/Vic/Josh. Entered by Mikey.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC came in -14.4% vs target on Monday ($3,611.18 net vs $4,220.34).** Marquee bar $3,972.30 gross; Garden closed; food $68.20. Voids $37 (1%); comps n/a. 71 guests / $51.59 GCA. **A super-slow, storm-dampened start (only four covers on the books) that turned into a successful Bar Acacia pop-up takeover.** A heavy industry crowd rolled in around 8pm, plus spillover from the conference next door; the takeover ran incredibly smoothly with glowing guest feedback, sold through all offerings by 11pm, then transitioned back to classics, with the building cleared by midnight - a strong learning rep for future takeovers. Wins: comms, run of show, staffing; to improve: cleaning as you go, water service. Maintenance: hot-water heater still acting up; ice-machine condensation + a PVC connection to seal; point-well leak repair scheduled Wed (operating from the mid well until Friday to allow drying). No incident; no-shows charged. MOD: Josh. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.weather: Warm and muggy with some rain around 3
venues.narrative: **Municipal Bar came in -0.8% vs target on Monday ($4,464 net vs $4,500).** Segments: AM bar $532 + PM bar $3,595 + Sun Club $299 + Hot Eye $0 (closed). Food $1,808. Comps $111. Event $0. 94 guests (26 AM / 68 PM). **A very quiet lunch (no reservations, low occupancy) brightened by two food tours, then a nice evening with a strong team** - a slow start gave way to a good wave of walk-ins as the sun set, with the bar turning at least twice. The crowd skews casual right now (drinks and a bite rather than big dinners), but volume was great for an offseason Monday. Sun Club drew a decent local crowd of hotel guests; kitchen handled the 7pm push aptly with no comps or sendbacks. Maintenance: a downstairs exit sign needs attention. (Backfilled - report posted 6/23 13:20 ET, after the prior run.) MOD: Sam (AM) / James (PM); Chef Marcus. Entered by James.
